'''Docking buoys''' were [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-based navigational aids. Thousands of docking buoys were stationed around [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] in the [[Besh Gorgon system/Legends|Besh Gorgon system]]. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] visiting The Wheel were stationed at the docking buoys, where [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] ferried passengers over to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
